sections.title: price() now rounds up to the next 5 cents
sections.summary:
`price` in src/pricing.ts +2 changed from returning `cents` as-is to `Math.ceil(cents / 5) * 5`. The test in src/pricing.test.ts was renamed and now checks `price(101)` → 105.

Things to check:
- Every item price, and so every cart total, now changes. `total` in src/cart.ts calls `price` on each item, so it rounds item by item, not once on the sum.
- Nothing tests the old case anymore: a price already on a 5-cent multiple (such as 100) staying the same, and 0 or negative inputs.

sections.title: Percentage discount wired into cart total
sections.summary:
`discount` in src/pricing.ts +14..+15 now takes a `percent` and subtracts `Math.round(cents * percent / 100)`. Before this change it ignored its input. `total` in src/cart.ts takes an optional `percent` (default 0) and applies the discount to the summed, already-rounded price.

Things to check:
- No tests cover `discount` or `total`.
- `percent` is not validated, so a value over 100 or below 0 gives a negative total or a surcharge.
- After the discount the total is no longer a 5-cent multiple. Decide whether that is intended.

   - The body of `fixtures/recorded.json` changed from `"first"` to `"second"`. Check whether you meant to change it.
